stance_summary: AUDNZD is a 5-year extreme built from NZD collapse, not AUD strength, while AU housing is already transmitting tightening, NZ labor is weak, NZ-positive news has not reversed the cross, and global event tails remain two-way after a post-FOMC vol crush. Spot short is the wrong expression because AU inflation 82 and a still-hiking AONIA strip can extend the squeeze, while outright long AUDNZD ignores housing, NZ GDP/FTA, and stretched location. Buy 3M AUDNZD downside convexity (25-delta AUD puts / NZD calls); implied vol, skew and premium are packet-null so the debate trade is options but the paper book stays HOLD.

expression_comparison.rates_candidate: Receive AONIA / short AU 2Y (packet AU 2Y 4.999 on 2026-09-16, 99.2nd 1y / 99.8th 5y; AONIA 4.35 pricing Oct 4.565, Nov 4.685, Mar-27 4.86) as a housing-transmission fade of remaining RBA hikes. Inferior: the same 1m +39bp analog set is mixed (2022-09-28 then sold off; 2023-05-10 and 2022-01-28 then kept selling bonds), AU inflation gauge is 82, and NZ rates are unavailable so the relative-rate RV cannot be marked.
expression_comparison.spot_candidate: Short AUDNZD spot versus 2026-09-18 ECB fix 1.2468 (1y/5y percentile 99.8/99.96, 1m +4.27%, 20d RV 5.09). Inferior: continuation risk if RBA stays the tighter G10 high-beta bank, carry vs NZ cannot be observed, and timing of housing versus inflation is unresolved.
expression_comparison.rationale: The discrepancy is path-and-timing, not a one-way fair-value gap. Spot short of AUDNZD has linear losses if AU inflation and the AONIA strip keep AUD bid through a 5y high; directional long AUDNZD ignores housing, NZ GDP beat, India FTA and NZ labor 32. A 3M 25-delta AUD put (NZD call) caps loss at premium, owns delayed AU housing plus NZD-positive catalysts, and still pays if the next move is a jump rather than a grind. Rates receive-AU is the same housing view with worse left-tail if inflation keeps the RBA hiking. No implied-vol or premium mids exist, so options dominate as the debate expression and remain untradeable in the paper book until marks appear.

context_build.causal_mechanism: Verified: the RBA tightening channel is already hitting Australian housing (NSW stamp-duty receipts -24% y/y, transactions -18%, Sydney/Melbourne values more than 7% from peak) while AU inflation temperature remains 82 and AONIA still prices roughly 50bp of extra tightening by March 2027. NZ inflation is also hot (gauge 80) but labor is 32, Q2 GDP slowed to 0.2% q/q yet beat forecasts, and parliament passed an India FTA covering about 95% of NZ exports. Inference: AUDNZD’s extreme is the market treating Australia as the cleaner high-beta tightener and New Zealand as the weaker high-beta, even though the new AU information is housing damage and the new NZ information is a growth beat plus a trade catalyst. Unknown: RBNZ path (official NZ yields 403). Options own the two-way transmission: either housing/NZ news reprice the cross lower, or residual RBA hawkishness and energy keep squeezing it higher.
context_build.path_to_current_price: Verified as of 2026-09-18 FX / 2026-09-16 AU rates. AUDNZD spot 1.2468, 1d +0.65% (z 1.99), 5d +1.19%, 1m +4.27% (log 4.18%, z 2.84), 3m only +2.05% (z -0.19) — the stretch is a one-month jump, not a three-month trend. AUDUSD 0.7120 is only 76th percentile 1y / 84th 5y and +0.20% 1m. NZDUSD 0.5711 is 13th percentile 1y / 8.6th 5y, -3.90% 1m, -0.56% 1d. So the cross high is NZD-weakness, not an AUD melt-up. AU 2Y rose to 4.999 (99.2nd 1y) with +39bp 1m then eased 5.5bp on 16 Sep. Fed hiked 25bp to 3.75-4.00 on 16 Sep after >90% pricing; SOFR jumped to 3.85 on 17 Sep; US 2Y 4.76 (100th percentile) and US 10Y 5.01 (99.8th). BoJ hiked to 1.25%. VIX fell 2.27 points to 15.44 (14.7th percentile) on 17 Sep — equity vol crushed after the Fed event. WTI 107.02 on 15 Sep (96th percentile, +24% 1m log). Inference: AUDNZD squeezed while global term rates repriced higher and then equity vol was sold; the cross did not get a vol-event premium in realized FX (20d RV only 5.09).
context_build.known_vs_new_information: Known: global tightening bias, energy shock, AU and NZ inflation gauges already hot, Fed hike was >90% priced into 16 Sep. New now: realized Fed hike to 3.75-4.00 and SOFR 3.85; documented AU housing tax/price break; NZ Q2 GDP 0.2% beat; NZ-India FTA passage; Saudi STS workaround that reduces the extreme oil-supply tail while a separate rollup says energy shock absorbers are weakening; BoJ 25bp to a 31-year high; BoE hold with 3 hike votes; VIX crush after FOMC. The AUDNZD 1m jump continued through the NZ-positive headlines and the housing evidence, which is why the move is not just old inflation news.
context_build.market_implied_assumption: Price requires that RBA tightening still dominates AUD versus NZD even after housing is breaking: AONIA 4.35 to 4.86 by Mar-27, AU 2Y at 4.999, AUDNZD at a 5y extreme. It also requires NZD to stay the residual high-beta loser despite a GDP beat, an India FTA, and CFTC leveraged-fund covering (NZD leveraged net weekly +15584 contracts to only -1766). Global pricing after the Fed event is more hikes (SR3 Dec-26 4.32, Mar-27 4.58, Sep-27 4.755) with cheap-looking equity vol (VIX 15.44). Implied FX vol, 25d risk-reversal and option premia are not in the packet — unknown whether the cross already pays for a reversal.
context_build.market_assumption_disagreed_with: Disagree that the next AUDNZD move is a one-direction grind that spot should own. The priced assumption — Australia remains the unambiguously tighter, cleaner high-beta and NZD has no bounce catalyst — is already in conflict with housing transmission, NZ labor 32, a GDP beat and an FTA. The opposite spot long (more AUDNZD upside) assumes inflation/energy keep dominating without a vol event. Both linear expressions are wrong when the mechanism can resolve either as a delayed AUD down-leg or a further RBA-led squeeze.
context_build.price_decomposition: Level versus change: AUDNZD level is 100th percentile on the 252-observation screen (z 1.96) because of a 1m +4.18% log move (z 2.84), while the 3m log move is only +2.03% (z -0.19). Pair components: AUDUSD almost unchanged on the month (+0.20%, 76th %ile); NZDUSD -3.90% (13th %ile). Rates component: AU-US 2Y only +26bp (25th %ile 1y) and AUDUSD vs AU-US 2Y residual is weak (r^2 0.007); AUDNZD vs AU-NZ 2Y is insufficient because NZ yields are missing. Vol component: AUDNZD 20d RV 5.09 / 60d 5.28 versus a 4.27% 1m spot move — jumpy relative to recent realized, not a high-vol regime. Carry screen for AUDNZD is unavailable. Energy: WTI 107 is a 96th-percentile inflator that can still support AUD on the commodity side. Marginal driver of the cross high is NZD underperformance plus residual RBA-hike pricing, not an AUDUSD breakout.

historical_reference.regime_differences: Today’s AU 2Y is already 4.999, not 0.88-3.57. Housing damage is already in the news tape, not just a forecast. Inflation gauges remain 82 AU / 80 NZ. Energy is a live 96th-percentile WTI shock with a Saudi workaround that cuts the extreme tail. Fed, BoJ and a split BoE have just printed. NZ official yields and therefore AU-NZ 2Y and AUDNZD-rate beta are missing, so 2022-style relative-rate analogs cannot be completed. Equity vol has already been crushed (VIX 15.44) after FOMC, which is a different vol regime than a 2022 hiking-vol expansion. Mixed analog outcomes plus those breaks are why bounded-premium options dominate a spot fade or a spot chase.

independent_checks: FX decomposition: AUDUSD not extreme (76th 1y, +0.2% 1m) versus NZDUSD weak (13th 1y, -3.9% 1m) identifies the AUDNZD high as NZD-driven.
Policy versus housing: AONIA still prices ~50bp of extra hikes into Mar-27 while NSW stamp duty -24% y/y and home values more than 7% off peak — the transmission is on, the path is still hawkish.

Temperature split: AU inflation 82 versus activity 54 / consumer 48; NZ inflation 80 versus labor 32 / activity 47 / consumer 38 — both countries are hot prices versus cooler real-side gauges, a two-way CB setup.

Positioning versus price: AUD leveraged funds net +61135 and adding +11356 week with OI at 99th 1y; NZD leveraged funds covering +15584 week to a small net short while asset managers are net long NZD at 97th 1y — not a clean one-way speculative pile into AUDNZD, and NZD covering has not yet shown up in NZDUSD.
Energy tape is two-way: WTI 107.02 (96th %ile, +24% 1m) versus Saudi Oman STS workaround reducing the extreme supply tail and a rollup that shock absorbers are weakening.

policy_path_check.rationale: AU and US paths are live and still price additional tightening after last week’s events; that is what keeps a spot short of AUDNZD dangerous in the near term. NZ cannot be used as a rates-RV leg. The options expression does not require a short-end NZ mark; it requires that the unresolved AU housing-versus-hikes and NZ growth-versus-inflation paths can move the cross discontinuously. A 2Y AU percentile is not treated as a substitute for the AONIA strip, which was inspected first.

trade.structure: Buy 3-month AUDNZD 25-delta puts (long AUD downside / NZD upside convexity). Preferred live construction once marks exist: compare outright 25d put versus 25d/10d put spread versus 25d risk-reversal (buy AUD puts, sell AUD calls) versus a 3M strangle if 25d skew already prices the downside. Do not sell the 25d call unless 25-delta risk-reversal, ATMF implied, and 20d/60d realized (5.09/5.28) are all observed. Strike, premium, implied vol and barrier levels are packet-null and must stay null.
trade.thesis: FACT: AUDNZD is at a 5-year extreme because NZDUSD collapsed, not because AUDUSD broke out; AU housing is showing the tightening channel; AONIA still prices ~50bp more hikes; NZ GDP beat and an India FTA have not reversed NZD; VIX crushed after FOMC; WTI is 96th percentile with a two-way energy narrative; NZ yields are missing; no FX option marks exist. INFERENCE: the market is pricing a one-way RBA-over-RBNZ regime that is already internally inconsistent, so the next move is a distribution with both a delayed mean-reversion tail and a squeeze tail. Spot is dominated because timing is uncertain and event risk (housing prints, energy, next RBA/RBNZ, residual global hike path) is two-sided after realized FX vol stayed ~5%. UNKNOWN: 3M ATMF IV, 25d risk-reversal, quoted premium, and the RBNZ curve — all must be checked before any OPEN. The paper book therefore HOLDs; the debate trade is still the put.
trade.mispricing: Not a claimed IV-versus-RV number (IV is absent). The mispricing is expression and distribution: linear AUDNZD short assumes the housing/NZ catalysts win on a timetable the analog set does not support; linear long assumes AU inflation 82 and energy keep paying after a 5y extreme. Bounded-premium 3M 25d puts own both the delayed AUD down-leg and jump risk, with max loss equal to premium rather than an open-ended squeeze. If live 3M implied already embeds a large AUDNZD reversal or rich 25d put skew versus 5% realized, the edge is gone — that check is mandatory and currently null.
why_now: AUDNZD just printed a 1m +4.27% jump to 5y 99.96th percentile while 3m is not stretched, so the location is fresh rather than a year-long grind.
AU housing evidence and NZ GDP/FTA are new relative to the still-hawkish AONIA strip and have not yet shown up in the cross.
Post-FOMC/BoJ event vol was sold in equities (VIX 15.44) while AUDNZD realized stayed ~5% despite a 4% monthly move — next catalysts are path-dependent, not the just-expired meetings.
CFTC NZD leveraged covering has not lifted NZDUSD, leaving a flow/price gap a put can own if the next impulse is a NZD bounce rather than another liquidation.
